lines.zh: 脚不落地，我踩着空气走。
lines.en: I walk on air, my feet never touching the ground.
This power is still held back.
I drift slowly over your head.

lines.zh: 地面太窄，我更喜欢天上。
lines.en: The ground is too cramped. I prefer the sky.

lines.zh: 一步一晃，气在脚下炸开。
lines.en: Each step cracks the air beneath me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，看清你的脸。
lines.en: I circle you to see your face.

lines.zh: 这片战场，我一步就跨过去。
lines.en: I cross this battlefield in a single step.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地上，比我慢。
lines.en: My shadow lands behind me, slower than I am.
Don't look up. The wind will sting your eyes.
I'm gathering power, so I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 脚下碎石自己浮起来了。
lines.en: The pebbles rise off the ground on their own.
I don't need a road.

lines.zh: 我停在你上方，一动不动。
lines.en: I stop above you and hold still.
My energy spirals around me.
This much isn't even a warm-up.
I stare at the distant mountains.
One breath, and the ground shakes.
I clench my fist and hold back.
You look very small to me.
I don't like being watched.
This chain is still loose.
Waiting for someone to provoke me.
I close my eyes and listen to the wind.
The power inside me keeps hitting a wall.
My breath bends the grass.
The sky is too blue. I don't like it.
You stand tall. That takes nerve.
Your energy is thin as paper.
Don't hide your fear in your eyes.
Are you here to die too?

lines.zh: 你那张脸，我刻在眼底了。
lines.en: I've burned your face behind my eyes.

lines.zh: 再近一格，我就放开链子。
lines.en: One block closer and I drop the chain.

lines.zh: 这股气我还压着，没全放开。
lines.en: I still hold this ki back, not fully released.

lines.zh: 你的气太薄，撑不住我一拳。
lines.en: Your ki is too thin to take one of my punches.
You don't have that kind of energy.
Lift your head and look into my eyes.
You're measuring the distance, aren't you.
I lower my voice. You heard it.
You think I'll strike first?
I can smell the fear on you.
There's no way back behind you.
I haven't blinked once.
Your smile is ugly.
This chain is about to snap.
This punch, you actually landed it.

lines.zh: 这点力气，连挠痒都不够。
lines.en: That barely counts as scratching.
A fistprint stays on my chest.
You actually dared to strike.
My teeth feel numb.

lines.zh: 我不会因为这点伤停下。
lines.en: I won't stop for this.
The taste of blood excites me.
Try that again.
I'll return this ten times over.
You left a mark on me.
You think food will buy me off?
That thing is far too small.
Food does not stir me.
Put it on the ground. Don't hand it to me.

lines.zh: 你手上那点东西，塞牙缝。
lines.en: That morsel wouldn't fill a tooth gap.
I smell it, but I don't care.
That meat is still three blocks away.
Once I eat, we fight, right?
I'm not picky. I swallow anything.
And you treat it like treasure.
I'm panting, and my ki still climbs.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我只退了半步。
lines.en: You hit me; I gave half a step.

lines.zh: 你的肩骨受不住这一撞。
lines.en: Your shoulder will not take this.
Is your shoulder still in one piece?
My energy held me in place.
You bounced off. I'm fine.
We collide, and the ground splits.
A casual shove, and you're off balance.
You can't stop me from landing.
Touch me and your hand goes numb.
A Saiyan's mate must be strong enough.
Not now. Don't bring that up.
I never stand beside the weak.
Her power has to hold mine down.
Even I cannot control myself.
Don't ask. I don't want to talk about it.
After this fight, we'll talk about other things.

lines.zh: 月亮出来的时候，我会想起谁。
lines.en: When the moon rises, I think of someone.
I just want to be alone.
Power is my only companion.

lines.zh: 这箱子，我一只手就捏碎。
lines.en: I could crush this chest in one hand.

lines.zh: 你的东西落地上，我收了。
lines.en: Your things fell; I collected them.
Shiny. What use is it?
I toss it into the sky.
I squeeze it. Iron.
You can't even protect this.
This wouldn't stop one punch from me.
I stuff it away and move on.
I pick it up with no intention of returning it.
So light. Like a leaf.
You've provoked me.
Now you don't leave.
I strike first. Bad luck for you.
I've locked onto your energy.
I felt you.
Move and I will have calculated it.
At this range, one step is all I need.
Your heartbeat falters and your ki leaks.
Super Saiyan power, held back.
Don't try to run. You can't.
I've loosened the chain a little.
Right now. I'm coming.

lines.zh: 你转身的那一瞬，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the instant you turned.
I don't need this chain anymore.
I won't bother remembering your name.
Let me see how strong you are.
I follow you from the sky.
Wherever you run, I can see you.
One punch brings me to your face.
Your energy is fading.
Don't look up. The wind will cut your face.

lines.zh: 我在你上面，慢慢压下来。
lines.en: I'm above you, slowly pressing down.
Circling won't help.

lines.zh: 我听见你的呼吸，也听见你怕。
lines.en: I hear your breathing, and your fear.
You think I can't catch you?
I'm slowing down on purpose.
Hide behind a tree and the tree falls.
I don't want to hold this chain any longer.

lines.zh: 你的每一步，我都算好了。
lines.en: I've already calculated every step of yours.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿都是这片天。
lines.en: Wherever you run, it's still my sky.
I'm in no rush to hit you.
I'll give you three more seconds.

lines.zh: 你每回头一次，我近一步。
lines.en: Every time you look back, I'm closer.

lines.zh: 受限的气，也够掀翻地面。
lines.en: Restricted ki still uproots the ground.
One punch, and a pillar of energy shoots up.
You fly off and crater the ground.
Can you take this kick?
An aerial combo. Don't bother counting.
It lands on your chest with a dull thud.
I chase you down and add another punch.
Small ki blasts, one after another.
You spun twice in the air.
That little pain is nothing, right?

lines.zh: 我的气还没放出来一半。
lines.en: Not even half my ki is out.
When you landed, I was already there.
This punch splits a mountain.
The shield in your hand shattered.
Aerial ki barrage.
I drive your head down into the ground.
Can you still stand?
I descend from the far edge of the sky.
The ground cracks before I even land.
The shockwave bends every tree.
You look up and see me.
This area belongs to me now.
I undid one clasp.
The chain clinked once.
I stand in the crater and look at you.
The wind stopped because I pushed it down.
My energy pushed the clouds aside.

lines.zh: 这片云下，又多一个活物。
lines.en: One more living thing under this cloud.
Don't run. I haven't started.
I undo one clasp and lift my head.
The soil under me crumbles to dust.
I clench my fist and my knuckles crack.
This sky is too quiet.
I'm here, and the quiet ends.
I lick my lips.
The fireball clings and burns.

lines.zh: 从天上摔下来，我也能站住。
lines.en: I can take a fall from the sky.
I can hold my breath underwater.

lines.zh: 这点气弹，还不够我热身。
lines.en: That ki blast barely warmed me up.
An arrow, stuck in my arm.

lines.zh: 咒语捆住我，挣一下试试。
lines.en: The spell binds me. Let me try to break it.
Starving this long, my energy scatters.
Lightning struck and my bones rang.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有空气，也没有底。
lines.en: No air in the void, and no floor.
